english_draft: Samsung Electronics reported Q3 2026 results on October 29, 2026. Consolidated revenue was KRW 195.3 trillion, up 14% quarter over quarter. Operating profit was KRW 107.4 trillion. The Device Solutions Division posted revenue of KRW 147.1 trillion and operating profit of KRW 106.5 trillion. The Memory Business set all-time highs in quarterly revenue and operating profit. Memory sales were driven by AI applications, HBM4, and server SSD demand. The Foundry Business improved on HBM base-die sales and 2nm HPC orders. The DX Division posted revenue up 8% quarter over quarter and an operating loss of KRW 0.8 trillion. The MX and Networks businesses recorded revenue of KRW 37.7 trillion and an operating loss of KRW 0.6 trillion. Costs pressured MX earnings despite an improved flagship mix. The VD/DA businesses recorded revenue of KRW 13.9 trillion and an operating loss of KRW 0.2 trillion. Samsung Display posted revenue of KRW 8.0 trillion and operating profit of KRW 1.1 trillion. Third-quarter capital expenditure was KRW 29 trillion. The full-year capital expenditure outlook for 2026 is about KRW 84.4 trillion. The Q3 cash dividend is KRW 4,601 per common and preferred share, totaling KRW 30 trillion. The company expects total shareholder returns of KRW 90-110 trillion for 2026. There was no same-period preview article before the results.
reader_questions: Operating profit of KRW 107.4 trillion exceeded KRW 100 trillion for the first time in the industry. Which segment contributed the most, and was the contribution sustainable?

The DS Division produced nearly all operating profit, while the DX Division recorded a loss. Did the company disclose whether DS profit was mainly from AI memory price increases or from one-off items?
The full-year 2026 capital expenditure outlook is KRW 84.4 trillion. Does this imply Q4 capex will be sharply higher, and what does the company say drives the investment?
fact_checks: Checked the official Samsung newsroom release. The report is for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, announced on October 29, 2026. All figures are in KRW and are consolidated unless segment figures are stated. Revenue of KRW 195.3 trillion and operating profit of KRW 107.4 trillion are consolidated. The DS Division figures are KRW 147.1 trillion revenue and KRW 106.5 trillion operating profit. Memory, Foundry, and System LSI are described qualitatively inside DS, with no separate segment profit numbers for each. DX: revenue up 8% QoQ, operating loss KRW 0.8 trillion. MX/Networks: revenue KRW 37.7 trillion, operating loss KRW 0.6 trillion, revenue increased QoQ and YoY. VD/DA: revenue KRW 13.9 trillion, operating loss KRW 0.2 trillion. SDC: revenue KRW 8.0 trillion, operating profit KRW 1.1 trillion. Capex: Q3 KRW 29 trillion, DS KRW 27.2 trillion, SDC KRW 1.1 trillion; 9-month total KRW 56.9 trillion; full-year guidance about KRW 84.4 trillion. Dividend: KRW 4,601 per common share and per preferred share, total KRW 30 trillion. Shareholder return range: KRW 90-110 trillion for 2026, with KRW 35 trillion planned or completed. No same-period preview article was available in the provided source set; the note says an afterwards reconstructed historical article exists and cannot be used as an actual prediction.
